services.name: Cruise the Erie Canal and through Locks 34 and 35
services.desc: Rates Adults - $26.00 Youth - $12.50 Children under 4 - Free AAA & CAA Members - $24.50 Duration 2 hours About Experience “Life in the Past Lane" when you get on board for your cruise on the historic Erie Canal, a 363-mile waterway between the Hudson River with Niagara River and the Great Lakes and an important part of American history. Your fun and informative cruise will take you past five of the original 1800's locks. Three million gallons of water will fill Locks 34 & 35, the only double set on the Erie Canal, and raise the boat 50 feet.
